properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Digest/MAC equality checks in ethers.js. Only the keystore MAC comparison is timing-sensitive (secret-derived MAC, local-file attacker model, low severity); the remaining sites compare public blockchain data or are idiomatic null checks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128-CTR is the cipher mandated by the Web3 Secret Storage v3 keystore format (ecosystem spec — observable constraint); implementation here is changeable. Integrity is provided by the format's keccak-256 MAC (macPrefix‖ciphertext) verified on decrypt, which covers CTR malleability; the IV comes from the CSPRNG (randomBytes(16), src.ts/wallet/json-keystore.ts:277).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 ECDH shared-secret derivation exposed as a public library API (SigningKey.computeSharedSecret, wrapper over @noble/curves). The library's own wallet/provider paths do not call it — it is a utility for downstream applications; the only in-tree consumer is the test suite. Changeable here (algorithm choice is Ethereum-ecosystem-fixed for on-chain use, but this API is for off-chain key agreement).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared transitive dependency @noble/curves@1.2.0 provides Ed25519 among its exports; ethers consumes the package for secp256k1, so the capability ships with every build. No Ed25519 call site found in the application code — available in the shipped library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared transitive dependency @noble/curves@1.2.0 provides P-256 (secp256r1); consumed by ethers for secp256k1, capability ships with the build. No P-256 call site found in the application code — available in the shipped library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt is the default password-based KDF for Web3 Secret Storage v3 keystore encryption (encrypt defaults N=131072/r=8/p=1, dkLen 32, 32-byte CSPRNG salt; decrypt honours the parameters stored in the file — observable format constraint, implementation changeable here). Implementation from @noble/hashes, bundled into the dist builds. Memory-hard at these defaults; scrypt itself has no PQ-specific weakness (symmetric KDF).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 (original Keccak padding 0x01, not FIPS-202 SHA3-256) is Ethereum's core hash: transaction/block/event hashing, address checksums, EIP-712 typed-data hashing, namehash, and the keystore MAC. The variant is fixed by the Ethereum protocol — replaceable only ecosystem-wide, not changeable here. 256-bit digest, quantum exposure is Grover-only (2^128 preimage), quantum-safe rating A-.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 serves three distinct derivations: (1) BIP39 mnemonic→seed, 2048 iterations of HMAC-SHA512 with 64-byte output — iteration count fixed by the BIP39 spec (observable constraint); (2) Web3 Secret Storage v3 'pbkdf2' KDF path — iteration count, dkLen and PRF are supplied by the keystore file being decrypted (attacker/generator chooses; Web3 spec recommends high counts); (3) legacy Ethereum presale/crowdsale wallets — 2000 iterations, SHA-256, password-as-salt (format-frozen legacy compatibil

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 utility exported as ethers.sha256; server path uses node:crypto createHash, browser path @noble/hashes. Consumed by callers for BIP32 fingerprinting (ripemd160(sha256(publicKey)), src.ts/wallet/hdwallet.ts:191/467) and general hashing; changeable here. 256-bit digest — A- quantum rating.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency @noble/hashes@1.3.2 supplying SHA-256; actively consumed on the browser path (src.ts/crypto/crypto-browser.ts:37 sha256.create()) and bundled into the dist builds, and used internally by scrypt/PBKDF2 constructions.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-512 utility (ethers.sha512), dual provider (node:crypto / @noble/hashes); SHA-512 is also the PRF inside HMAC-SHA512 used for BIP32 HD-wallet master-key and child-key derivation (src.ts/wallet/hdwallet.ts:81,320). Meets CNSA 2.0 digest sizes.
